thesis: Raised guidance is positive evidence but claims and reserves needed to validate it are absent. Neither side can establish the quality of the recovery from industrial ratios.
strongest_counterexample: Raised annual guidance and adjusted EPS of $6.38 give concrete issuer support to the recovery thesis.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if management cuts the current annual adjusted EPS guidance.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters meet or exceed disclosed adjusted EPS guidance without adverse reserve development.
evidence_gaps: Medical-loss ratio, reserve development and regulated capital.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Raised guidance provides dated evidence for a recovery scenario
Raised guidance is relevant evidence for recovery, but a thin net margin makes claims assumptions and reserve adequacy decisive
